name: CCI correction: weekly +/-100 bias with daily CCI reversal
author: Donald Lambert CCI; StockCharts correction tweak
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Weekly CCI surged above +100 sets bullish bias (stays until weekly CCI < -100). When bias is bullish and daily CCI falls below -100, buy when daily CCI then surges back into positive territory (above 0).
entry_short: Weekly CCI < -100 sets bearish bias (until weekly CCI > +100). With bearish bias and daily CCI above +100, sell short when daily CCI plunges back below 0.
exit: Source defines no explicit exit; Lambert original exits when CCI falls back below +100. Bias flip is the natural invalidation.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: Weekly CCI bias; daily CCI extreme; 26-period CCI in the examples
